name: std::basic_string_view<CharT,Traits>::empty
intro: Checks if the view has no characters, i.e. whether size() == 0.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: true if the view is empty, false otherwise.

examples.output:
'' has 0 character(s); emptiness: true
'./a.out' has 7 character(s); emptiness: false
